verses.text: The children of promise find rest, knowing that peace settles upon the patient heart, and the generous find joy that does not fade.
The faithful hold fast, remembering that the humble are lifted in their season.
Those who trust hold fast, trusting that light is given to those who walk in truth, and the weary are strengthened by quiet trust.
The steadfast press onward, for light is given to those who walk in truth, and grace meets the one who waits with courage.
The children of promise rejoice, and hope is renewed with each new morning, and the weary are strengthened by quiet trust.
The people bow in reverence, because understanding grows where the heart stays open.
All who listen walk humbly, knowing that the humble are lifted in their season, and grace meets the one who waits with courage.
The steadfast give thanks, remembering that light is given to those who walk in truth.
Those who trust hold fast, remembering that kindness returns to the one who gives it freely.
Those who trust rejoice, for faith is made strong through steady obedience, and the humble are lifted in their season.
The gathered assembly hold fast, because kindness returns to the one who gives it freely, and the humble are lifted in their season.
The humble remember, remembering that faith is made strong through steady obedience.
Every willing heart press onward, because the generous find joy that does not fade, and kindness returns to the one who gives it freely.
The people press onward, trusting that faith is made strong through steady obedience.
The faithful walk humbly, and understanding grows where the heart stays open.
The steadfast lift up their voices, and peace settles upon the patient heart.
The righteous press onward, trusting that mercy is shown to those who seek wisdom, and a gentle answer turns away the storm.
Those who trust find rest, remembering that the generous find joy that does not fade.
